rv.q: It’s lively, inventive, mildly parodic fun, if occasionally a little too pleased with its own ingenuity.
As on screen, the dinosaurs steal the show, rendered here with brilliant physical comedy.
This is a show that should never go extinct.
Hold On To Your Butts is perfect for dinosaur fans of all ages looking for a great laugh with technically skilled performers and an excellent use of sound.

cn.t: Critics are split on this lo-fi Jurassic Park parody. Most praise its clever physical comedy and impressive three-person execution, though some find it insubstantial—best enjoyed by fans who know the source material.
